lines.en: Noriko volunteers to come over to my place the moment I call her, and I reluctantly accept despite the existence of Ami and how that's sure to make her feel.
lines.zh: 我一打电话，Noriko 就自告奋勇要来我家，而我虽然不情愿，还是答应了——尽管 Ami 的存在必定会让她不好受。

lines.en: She hates it, of course. And she tries to prevent me from leaving by wrapping her entire body around my legs, which I just kick her off before apologizing and walking through the door.
lines.zh: 她当然讨厌这样。她把整个身子缠上我的腿，想不让我走——我直接把她甩开，道了歉，然后走出门去。

lines.en: I meet up with Noriko a few blocks away from the house, and we decide it's best to stay in this area so that Ami's body will still be warm when we find it dead a little while from now.
lines.zh: 我在离家几个街区的地方和 Noriko 碰头，我们决定最好就待在这一带——这样过一会儿我们找到 Ami 的尸体时，它还是热的。

lines.en: I think that would make Noriko happy. She's been put off by Ami's existence lately- which I don't blame her for after what she's witnessed and gone through.
lines.zh: 我觉得那会让 Noriko 高兴。她最近一直被 Ami 的存在弄得不舒服——而看了她所目睹、所经历的一切，我并不怪她。

lines.en: In fact, I don't blame anyone for the way they look at my niece now. But I feel especially bad for Noriko as, from her point of view, it's probably like I don't see her at all.
lines.zh: 事实上，我谁也不怪——不管他们现在用怎样的眼光看我的侄女。但我格外同情 Noriko，因为在她看来，大概就像我根本没看见她一样。

lines.en: And that's true to a certain extent, but not entirely true. I mean, parts of me have entered parts of her. And that has to count for something.
lines.zh: 这话在某种程度上是对的，但也并不全然。我是说，我身上某些部分已经进过她某些部分了。这总得算点什么吧。

lines.en: But between Niki and Ami, it's like I'm always closer to someone than I am to her. And I'll never stop being impressed by the way she can persevere despite that.
lines.zh: 可是夹在 Niki 和 Ami 之间，我好像永远都离别人更近，离她更远。而她能在这种情况下坚持下来，我永远都佩服。

lines.en: I hope to be as strong as her one day. But considering I've made it 31 years into life without achieving that, I can't imagine I ever will.
lines.zh: 我希望有一天能像她一样坚强。但考虑到我这 31 年的人生都还没能做到，我想我永远也做不到。

lines.en: Which means I'll just have to live vicariously through her. And while that comes with many downsides, I can take solace in the fact that I'm already used to hurting myself.
lines.zh: 也就是说，我只能借着她的人生去体验了。虽然这有不少坏处，但至少有一件事能安慰我：我已经习惯伤害自己了。

lines.en: So that part won't be hard at all.
lines.zh: 所以这一点一点也不难。
Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!
